note: Phone releases named cN for the 1.0.21 full host (1021-full), on stock 1.0.6.11. phone_pins.py reads this file and exact release ZIPs under $TURBO_INPUTS to generate FirmwarePins.h and firmware-pins-<name>.json; the gate checks them. C22 is the only release. Packages are ordered TMG12 (selected at every launch), STOCK-1.0.6.11 (the way back), then external Turbo-IO TMIG2-VIDEO-R1. TMG12 and stock accept 1.0.5.12 or 1.0.6.11; R1 accepts only 1.0.6.11. R1 has never been flashed from C22, nor on real glasses as far as its publisher reports. This fork's Turbo phone features target TMG12 and are not expected to work on R1.

c22.builds: C22: TMG12 (default), stock 1.0.6.11, or third-party TMIG2-VIDEO-R1, picked in the wizard, from the 1.0.21 full host
